# Introduction

The **`datetimeconverter`** analysis (DateTime Converter) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Convert datetime variables to standardized format and extract datetime components (year, month, day, hour, minute, day name, week number, quarter, etc.). Features automatic format detection, quality assessment, and preview of converted data. Perfect for preparing datetime data for analysis and creating time-based variables.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("datetimeconverter_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::datetimeconverter(
#   data = datetimeconverter_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `datetimeconverter` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
